title: Why an Octopus Has Three Hearts and Blue Blood

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts, and one of them stops every time it swims.
Two hearts pump blood through its gills. The third pushes it to the rest of the body.
When an octopus swims, that main heart actually stops beating.
That's exhausting, which is why octopuses prefer to crawl instead of swim.
And its blood isn't red. It's blue, because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen.
Three hearts, blue blood, and a mini brain in every arm. Aliens already live in our oceans.

description:
Octopuses have three hearts: two for the gills and one for the body, and the body heart stops when they swim.
Their blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.
What's the strangest animal you know?
